summary: THOR Industries filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, announcing that its board declared an increased regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.54 per share, a 3.8% rise from the prior $0.52, payable November 10, 2026 to holders of record October 27, 2026. The filing includes the press release as Exhibit 99.1; no advisor or board recommendation beyond approval is disclosed. Mechanics are routine: a NYSE-listed common stock dividend with no overhang, collateral, or regulatory clock. Watch for future payout sustainability given RV demand cyclicality and tariff/input cost pressures.
